item.title: Downtown Bend library will be closed for a year, renovations - Backyardbend
item.description: The newly constructed Central Library at Stevens Ranch will open this spring as the Downtown Bend Public Library will close for a year for renovations.

item.title: New program at Crook County Highschool, aviation - Backyardbend
item.description: A new program at Crook County High School in Prineville will offer students a chance to learn about the aviation industry and flying careers. Learn more about it here.

item.title: New standard of protected bike lane roundabouts - Backyardbend
item.description: Will protected bike lanes be the new standard for roundabout construction around Bend? The City of Bend is in the process of creating new transportation standards for the city. Learn more about it here.

item.title: Graduation rates are up post-pandemic - Backyardbend

item.title: $42M approved for OSU-Cascades - Backyardbend

item.title: Central Oregon Locavore will expand into a new location - Backyardbend

item.title: Record-low snowpack in Central Oregon - Backyardbend
item.description: Snow surveyors have raised warning flags in Central Oregon, with snow levels sitting at the lowest they've been in 36 years of record-keeping. Learn more about it here.
